Figure 6g uses the saved ASD-gene overlap null distributions. Figure 6h uses the original balanced case/control variant downsampling analysis. The two analyses use different tail calculations and must not be described as a single shuffled-label permutation procedure.

The gene-overlap result retains its recorded one-sided normal-tail statistic. The variant result retains its empirical sign tail across 1,000 balanced subsets. Parameters, full native implementation and gene-set resampling code are included below. A default render does not draw new random subsets.

## Inputs and saved objects

Paths are relative to the `CortexCode/` directory. **saved-results** inputs support routine rendering; **optional-rerun** inputs are read only when the corresponding analysis is enabled. Wildcards identify file collections.

| Mode | Input path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig6_KC/*.csv` | Fig6_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Extended_Fig8_KC/*.csv` | Extended_Fig8_KC: numerical plotting tables (collection) |
| optional-rerun | `data/upstream/variants/NIHMS1844621-supplement-Supplementary_Table.xlsx` | Fu ASD gene sets, sheet 11 |
| optional-rerun | `data/upstream/RNA/*_wt_vs_mut_DE_Litter_Sex_cor.csv` | Original RNA statistics for gene-set nulls |
| optional-rerun | `data/upstream/final_tables/H3K27Me3_FTneg*.csv` | Original nonVZ ME3 differential peak results |
| optional-rerun | `data/upstream/final_tables/Supp_Table_1_ATAC_master.csv` | ATAC interval catalog for variant restriction |
| optional-rerun | `data/upstream/GENOA/*` | GENOA source region collections; selected filename is explicit in notebook |

See [input locations](INPUTS.md), [saved R objects](SAVED_OBJECTS.md) and the [complete file inventory](config/file_inventory.csv) for original source names, sizes and availability. These large inputs are not part of the Git checkout.

## ASD-gene set construction and null distribution

The original Fu et al. supplementary workbook (sheet 11), human-to-mouse orthology strategy and `permutation_test_fu` counting algorithm are included below. Each replicate draws the observed number of significant genes without replacement from the complete supplied DE table. Inference uses a one-sided normal tail from the null mean and sample SD, rather than an empirical exceedance fraction. The source used parallel resampling without an explicit parallel RNG policy; this portable sequential implementation preserves the test but does not claim bitwise reproduction of its 10,000 draws. Default plots retain the original saved null distribution. The historical orthology database version was not recorded.

```{r native-gene-set-null, eval=isTRUE(params$run_gene_null)}

library(readxl)
library(orthogene)
fu <- na.omit(
  as.data.frame(
    readxl::read_excel(
      file.path(
        REPO, "data", "upstream", "variants", "NIHMS1844621-supplement-Supplementary_Table.xlsx"
      ),
      sheet = 11
    )
  )
)
# Preserve the original orthogene non-1:1 strategy. An updated orthology
# database can change membership; save the returned mapping with any rerun.
human_mouse_orthologs <- orthogene::convert_orthologs(
  gene_df = fu[, 2][!duplicated(fu[, 2])],
  gene_input = "rownames",
  gene_output = "rownames",
  input_species = "human",
  output_species = "mouse",

  non121_strategy = 1
)
human_mouse_orthologs$Mouse_ortholog <- rownames(human_mouse_orthologs)
human_mouse_orthologs$index <- NULL
rownames(human_mouse_orthologs) <- NULL
colnames(human_mouse_orthologs) <- c("gene_gencodeV33", "Mouse_ortholog")
fu <- merge(fu, human_mouse_orthologs, all = TRUE)

gene_set_enrichment <- function(
  de_table,
  fu_table,
  gene_set = "ASD185",
  adjusted = FALSE,
  threshold = 0.05,

  repetitions = 10000L
) {
  set.seed(1234)
  set_genes <- fu_table$Mouse_ortholog[fu_table[[gene_set]] %in% TRUE]
  set_genes <- set_genes[!is.na(set_genes)]
  membership <- de_table$gene_name %in% set_genes
  significant <- if (adjusted) {
    de_table$FDR < threshold
  } else {
    de_table$PValue < threshold
  }
  stopifnot(!anyNA(significant))
  n_significant <- sum(significant)
  observed <- sum(membership[significant])
  # Same without-replacement gene draws and normal-tail inference as
  # permutation_test_fu(); scheduling is sequential and no global
  # significant_genes variable is modified.
  null <- replicate(repetitions,
    sum(sample(membership, size = n_significant, replace = FALSE)))
  z <- (observed - mean(null))/sd(null)
  list(
    observed = observed,
    null = null,
    z = z,
    p = pnorm(z, lower.tail = FALSE),

    tested_gene_membership = membership,
    orthology = human_mouse_orthologs
  )
}
gene_output <- file.path(REPO, "objects", "variants", "recomputed_genes")
dir.create(gene_output,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE)
for (population in c("VZ", "nonVZ")) {
  de <- read.csv(
    file.path(
      REPO, "data", "upstream", "RNA", paste0(population, "_wt_vs_mut_DE_Litter_Sex_cor.csv")
    )
  )
  result <- gene_set_enrichment(de, fu, gene_set = "ASD185")
  saveRDS(result, file.path(gene_output, paste0(population, "_ASD185.rds")))
}

```

## Complete balanced-downsampling implementation

The selected original analysis class is included directly. It contains variant parsing, lift-over, interval selection and merging, case/control balancing, matched resampling, overlap counts and empirical inference. Defining this class alone does not run any simulation.

```{r native-variant-class, eval=isTRUE(params$run_variant_analysis)}
# Original final balanced-downsampling implementation.
# Source: Var_enr_short_obj_oriented.Rmd, ME3_Exact_Enrichment_Run.
# No analysis is executed by sourcing this class definition.

ME3_Exact_Enrichment_Run <- R6::R6Class(
  classname = "ME3_Exact_Enrichment_Run",
  public = list(

    paths = NULL,
    cfg = NULL,
    log_df = NULL,

    me3_df_raw = NULL,
    me3_regions = NULL,
    atac_gr = NULL,
    genoa_gr = NULL,

    var_human_df = NULL,
    var_human_gr = NULL,
    var_lifted_gr = NULL,
    var_filtered_gr = NULL,
    cases_gr = NULL,
    ctrls_gr = NULL,

    case_overlap_table = NULL,
    control_overlap_table = NULL,
    per_region_counts = NULL,

    null_reps = NULL,
    melted_stats = NULL,
    p_values = NULL,
    violin_plot = NULL,
    violin_plot_mut1 = NULL,

    initialize = function(
      me3_diffbind_path,
      atac_path,
      genoa_path,
      variants_tsv_path,
      liftover_chain_path,
      n_null_reps = 1000L,
      downsample_to = 5000L,
      downsample_frac = 0.8,
      rand_seed = 1234L,
      verbose = TRUE
    ) {
      self$paths <- list(
        me3_diffbind_path   = me3_diffbind_path,
        atac_path           = atac_path,
        genoa_path          = genoa_path,
        variants_tsv_path   = variants_tsv_path,
        liftover_chain_path = liftover_chain_path
      )

      self$cfg <- list(
        variant_filter = "atac_and_genoa",
        me3_p_thr = 0.05,
        me3_log2fc_thr = 0,
        me3_expand_lr_bp = 0L,
        atac_expand_lr_bp = 0L,
        merge_overlapping_ME3_intervals = TRUE,
        max_me3_region_size = 50000L,
        thresholds_k = c(0L, 1L, 2L),   # >0, >1, >2 mutations per region
        n_null_reps = as.integer(n_null_reps),
        downsample_to = as.integer(downsample_to),
        downsample_frac = as.numeric(downsample_frac),
        rand_seed = as.integer(rand_seed),
        verbose = isTRUE(verbose)
      )

      self$log_df <- data.frame(
        step = character(),
        message = character(),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    },

    logit = function(step, message) {
      self$log_df <- bind_rows(
        self$log_df,
        data.frame(step = step,
          message = message,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      )
    },

    compute_log2fc = function(df) {
      df <- as.data.frame(df)

      if ("unshrunk_l2fc" %in% names(df)) {
        df$log2FC <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$unshrunk_l2fc))
        return(df)
      }

      if (all(c("Conc_expr", "Conc_ctrl") %in% names(df))) {
        df$log2FC <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$Conc_expr) - as.numeric(df$Conc_ctrl))
        return(df)
      }

      if (all(c("Conc_Kdm6b_expr", "Conc_Kdm6b_ctrl") %in% names(df))) {
        df$log2FC <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$Conc_Kdm6b_expr) - as.numeric(df$Conc_Kdm6b_ctrl))
        return(df)
      }

      stop("Cannot compute log2FC from supplied ME3 table.")
    },

    expand_lr = function(gr, bp) {
      bp <- as.integer(bp)
      if (is.na(bp) || bp <= 0L) return(gr)

      gr2 <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
        seqnames = seqnames(gr),
        ranges = IRanges::IRanges(
          start = pmax(1L, start(gr) - bp),
          end   = end(gr) + bp
        ),
        strand = strand(gr)
      )
      mcols(gr2) <- mcols(gr)
      genome(gr2) <- genome(gr)
      gr2
    },

    harmonize_pair = function(x, y) {
      common <- intersect(seqlevels(x), seqlevels(y))
      list(
        x = keepSeqlevels(x, common, pruning.mode = "coarse"),

        y = keepSeqlevels(y,
        common,
        pruning.mode = "coarse")
      )
    },

    read_variants_robust = function(path) {
      needed <- c("chr","start","ID","REF","ALT","TYPE","LEN","FAM","SAMPLE","STATUS")
      df <- readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

      if (all(needed %in% names(df))) {
        return(
          df %>%
            select(all_of(needed)) %>%
            mutate(
              start = as.integer(start),
              LEN   = as.integer(LEN),
              end   = start + LEN
            ) %>%
            select(chr, start, end, ID, REF, ALT, TYPE, LEN, FAM, SAMPLE, STATUS)
        )
      }

      if (ncol(df) == 10) {
        colnames(df) <- needed
        df$start <- as.integer(df$start)
        df$LEN   <- as.integer(df$LEN)
        df$end   <- df$start + df$LEN
        return(df[, c("chr","start","end","ID","REF","ALT","TYPE","LEN","FAM","SAMPLE","STATUS")])
      }

      stop("Variant TSV has unexpected format.")
    },

    load_me3_regions = function() {
      self$logit("ME3", "Loading ME3 DiffBind table and selecting regions")

      df <- read.csv(self$paths$me3_diffbind_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      df <- self$compute_log2fc(df)

      df$p.value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$p.value))
      df$width   <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(df$width))

      self$me3_df_raw <- df

      df2 <- df %>%
        filter(
          is.finite(p.value), p.value < self$cfg$me3_p_thr,
          is.finite(log2FC),  log2FC  > self$cfg$me3_log2fc_thr,
          is.finite(width),   width   < self$cfg$max_me3_region_size
        )

      if (!nrow(df2)) stop("No ME3 intervals pass filters.")

      gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
        seqnames = df2$seqnames,
        ranges   = IRanges::IRanges(as.integer(df2$start), as.integer(df2$end)),
        strand   = if ("strand" %in% names(df2)) df2$strand else "*"
      )
      genome(gr) <- "mm10"
      mcols(gr)$p.value <- df2$p.value
      mcols(gr)$log2FC  <- df2$log2FC

      gr <- self$expand_lr(gr, self$cfg$me3_expand_lr_bp)
      gr <- gr[width(gr) < self$cfg$max_me3_region_size]

      if (isTRUE(self$cfg$merge_overlapping_ME3_intervals)) {
        gr <- GenomicRanges::reduce(gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
        genome(gr) <- "mm10"
      }

      mcols(gr)$region_id <- paste0("ME3_", seq_along(gr))
      self$me3_regions <- gr

      self$logit("ME3", paste0("Selected ", length(gr), " ME3 loci"))
      invisible(gr)
    },

    load_atac_and_genoa = function() {
      self$logit("SETS", "Loading ATAC and GENOA")

      atac <- read.csv(self$paths$atac_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      gr_atac <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
        seqnames = atac$seqnames,
        ranges   = IRanges::IRanges(as.integer(atac$start), as.integer(atac$end)),
        strand   = "*"
      )
      genome(gr_atac) <- "mm10"
      gr_atac <- self$expand_lr(gr_atac, self$cfg$atac_expand_lr_bp)
      self$atac_gr <- gr_atac

      genoa <- read.table(self$paths$genoa_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      colnames(genoa)[1:3] <- c("chr", "start", "end")
      gr_genoa <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
        seqnames = genoa$chr,
        ranges   = IRanges::IRanges(as.integer(genoa$start), as.integer(genoa$end)),
        strand   = "*"
      )
      genome(gr_genoa) <- "mm10"
      self$genoa_gr <- gr_genoa

      self$logit("SETS",
        paste0("ATAC=", length(self$atac_gr), " GENOA=", length(self$genoa_gr)))
      invisible(TRUE)
    },

    load_and_filter_variants = function() {
      self$logit("VAR", "Loading, lifting over, and filtering variants")

      var_df <- self$read_variants_robust(self$paths$variants_tsv_path)
      self$var_human_df <- var_df
      self$var_human_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(var_df)

      chain <- rtracklayer::import.chain(self$paths$liftover_chain_path)
      lifted <- unlist(rtracklayer::liftOver(self$var_human_gr, chain))
      genome(lifted) <- "mm10"
      self$var_lifted_gr <- lifted

      v0 <- lifted[lifted$STATUS != "missing"]
      genome(v0) <- "mm10"
      v0$..idx.. <- seq_along(v0)

      # exact requested filter: atac_and_genoa
      h1 <- self$harmonize_pair(v0, self$atac_gr)
      hits1 <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(h1$x, h1$y, ignore.strand = TRUE))
      hit_atac <- rep(FALSE, length(v0))
      hit_atac[h1$x$..idx..[unique(queryHits(hits1))]] <- TRUE

      h2 <- self$harmonize_pair(v0, self$genoa_gr)
      hits2 <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(h2$x, h2$y, ignore.strand = TRUE))
      hit_genoa <- rep(FALSE, length(v0))
      hit_genoa[h2$x$..idx..[unique(queryHits(hits2))]] <- TRUE

      keep <- hit_atac & hit_genoa
      v0$..idx.. <- NULL

      v_filt <- v0[keep]
      self$var_filtered_gr <- v_filt
      self$cases_gr <- v_filt[v_filt$STATUS == "case"]
      self$ctrls_gr <- v_filt[v_filt$STATUS == "control"]

      self$logit(
        "VAR",
        paste0(
          "Filtered variants: case=", length(self$cases_gr),
          " control=", length(self$ctrls_gr)
        )
      )
      invisible(v_filt)
    },

    build_overlap_tables = function() {
      self$logit("OVERLAP", "Building overlap tables against final ME3 loci")

      # harmonize for case
      h_case <- self$harmonize_pair(self$me3_regions, self$cases_gr)
      regs_case <- h_case$x
      cases2 <- h_case$y

      ov_case <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(regs_case, cases2, ignore.strand = TRUE))
      case_tbl <- tibble(
        region_id      = mcols(regs_case)$region_id[queryHits(ov_case)],
        seqnames       = as.character(seqnames(regs_case))[queryHits(ov_case)],
        start          = start(regs_case)[queryHits(ov_case)],
        end            = end(regs_case)[queryHits(ov_case)],
        width          = width(regs_case)[queryHits(ov_case)],
        variant_chr    = as.character(seqnames(cases2))[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        variant_start  = start(cases2)[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        variant_end    = end(cases2)[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        ID             = mcols(cases2)$ID[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        REF            = mcols(cases2)$REF[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        ALT            = mcols(cases2)$ALT[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        TYPE           = mcols(cases2)$TYPE[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        LEN            = mcols(cases2)$LEN[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        FAM            = mcols(cases2)$FAM[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        SAMPLE         = mcols(cases2)$SAMPLE[subjectHits(ov_case)],
        STATUS         = mcols(cases2)$STATUS[subjectHits(ov_case)]
      )

      # harmonize for control
      h_ctrl <- self$harmonize_pair(self$me3_regions, self$ctrls_gr)
      regs_ctrl <- h_ctrl$x
      ctrls2 <- h_ctrl$y

      ov_ctrl <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(regs_ctrl, ctrls2, ignore.strand = TRUE))
      ctrl_tbl <- tibble(
        region_id      = mcols(regs_ctrl)$region_id[queryHits(ov_ctrl)],
        seqnames       = as.character(seqnames(regs_ctrl))[queryHits(ov_ctrl)],
        start          = start(regs_ctrl)[queryHits(ov_ctrl)],
        end            = end(regs_ctrl)[queryHits(ov_ctrl)],
        width          = width(regs_ctrl)[queryHits(ov_ctrl)],
        variant_chr    = as.character(seqnames(ctrls2))[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        variant_start  = start(ctrls2)[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        variant_end    = end(ctrls2)[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        ID             = mcols(ctrls2)$ID[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        REF            = mcols(ctrls2)$REF[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        ALT            = mcols(ctrls2)$ALT[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        TYPE           = mcols(ctrls2)$TYPE[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        LEN            = mcols(ctrls2)$LEN[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        FAM            = mcols(ctrls2)$FAM[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        SAMPLE         = mcols(ctrls2)$SAMPLE[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)],
        STATUS         = mcols(ctrls2)$STATUS[subjectHits(ov_ctrl)]
      )

      self$case_overlap_table <- case_tbl
      self$control_overlap_table <- ctrl_tbl

      case_counts <- case_tbl %>%
        dplyr::count(region_id, name = "n_case_mut") %>%
        right_join(tibble(region_id = mcols(self$me3_regions)$region_id),
          by = "region_id") %>%
        mutate(n_case_mut = replace_na(n_case_mut, 0L))

      ctrl_counts <- ctrl_tbl %>%
        dplyr::count(region_id, name = "n_ctrl_mut") %>%
        right_join(tibble(region_id = mcols(self$me3_regions)$region_id),
          by = "region_id") %>%
        mutate(n_ctrl_mut = replace_na(n_ctrl_mut, 0L))

      self$per_region_counts <- case_counts %>%
        left_join(ctrl_counts, by = "region_id") %>%
        mutate(n_ctrl_mut = replace_na(n_ctrl_mut, 0L))

      invisible(self$per_region_counts)
    },

    resolve_downsample_to = function() {
      n_min <- min(length(self$cases_gr), length(self$ctrls_gr))
      used_frac <- floor(n_min * self$cfg$downsample_frac)
      ds_used <- min(self$cfg$downsample_to, used_frac)
      if (ds_used < 1L) stop("downsample_to_used < 1")
      as.integer(ds_used)
    },

    calc_pvalues_from_reps = function(reps_df) {
      reps_df %>%
        group_by(k, MinMutPerRegion) %>%
        summarise(
          mean_n_case      = mean(n_case),
          mean_n_ctrl      = mean(n_ctrl),
          median_n_case    = median(n_case),
          median_n_ctrl    = median(n_ctrl),
          sd_n_case        = sd(n_case),
          sd_n_ctrl        = sd(n_ctrl),
          mean_diff        = mean(diff),
          median_diff      = median(diff),
          sd_diff          = sd(diff),
          enrichment_ratio = ifelse(mean(n_ctrl) > 0, mean(n_case) / mean(n_ctrl), NA_real_),
          P_null1_1sided   = (sum(diff <= 0) + 1) / (n() + 1),
          P_null1_2sided   = pmin(
            1,
            2 * pmin(
              (sum(diff <= 0) + 1) / (n() + 1),
              1 - ((sum(diff <= 0) + 1) / (n() + 1))
            )
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        arrange(k)
    },

    build_violin_plot_all = function(stat_long) {
      ggplot(
        stat_long,
        aes(x = factor(MinMutPerRegion),
          y = n_regions,
          fill = group)
      ) +
        geom_violin(trim = FALSE,
          alpha = 0.5,
          position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
        labs(
          title = "Null resampling distributions of ME3-overlapped regions",
          subtitle = "Exact condition: atac_and_genoa, p<0.05, log2FC>0, ME3 expand=0, ATAC expand=0, merge=TRUE",

          x = "Minimum mutations per region",
          y = "# regions passing threshold",
          fill = NULL
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 12)
    },

    build_violin_plot_mut1 = function(stat_long, p_values_tbl) {
      plot_df <- stat_long %>%
        filter(MinMutPerRegion == 1) %>%
        mutate(group = factor(group,
          levels = c("control", "case")))

      p_row <- p_values_tbl %>% filter(MinMutPerRegion == 1)
      p_lab <- if (nrow(p_row) == 1) {
          paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.5f", p_row$P_null1_1sided), " (Permutation test)")
            } else {
              "P = NA"
    }

      ggplot(plot_df,
        aes(x = group, y = n_regions, fill = group, color = group)) +
        geom_violin(trim = FALSE,
          alpha = 0.22,
          linewidth = 0.7,
          width = 0.7) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.16,
          height = 0,
          alpha = 0.18,
          size = 1.8,
          stroke = 0) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("control" = "#00BFC4", "case" = "#F8766D")) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("control" = "#00BFC4", "case" = "#F8766D")) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(">0 mut. per region\n[", p_lab, "]"),
          x = NULL,
          y = "Regions with intersecting mutations [counts]"
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
        theme(
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "plain"),

          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),

          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),

          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        )
    },

    run_null = function() {
      self$logit("NULL", "Running case/control resampling null")

      set.seed(self$cfg$rand_seed)

      h_case <- self$harmonize_pair(self$cases_gr, self$me3_regions)
      cases2 <- h_case$x
      regs2  <- h_case$y

      h_ctrl <- self$harmonize_pair(self$ctrls_gr, regs2)
      ctrls2 <- h_ctrl$x
      regs2  <- h_ctrl$y

      ds_used <- self$resolve_downsample_to()
      ks <- self$cfg$thresholds_k

      one_rep <- function(rep_id) {
        case_hits <- countOverlaps(
          regs2,
          sample(cases2, ds_used, replace = FALSE),
          ignore.strand = TRUE
        )
        ctrl_hits <- countOverlaps(
          regs2,
          sample(ctrls2, ds_used, replace = FALSE),
          ignore.strand = TRUE
        )

        bind_rows(lapply(ks, function(k) {
          tibble(
            rep = rep_id,
            k = k,
            MinMutPerRegion = k + 1L,
            n_case = sum(case_hits > k),
            n_ctrl = sum(ctrl_hits > k),
            diff = sum(case_hits > k) - sum(ctrl_hits > k)
          )
        }))
      }

      reps_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(self$cfg$n_null_reps), one_rep))
      self$null_reps <- reps_df

      stat_long <- reps_df %>%
        pivot_longer(
          cols = c(n_case, n_ctrl),
          names_to = "group",
          values_to = "n_regions"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          group = recode(group,
          n_case = "case",
          n_ctrl = "control")
        )

      self$melted_stats <- stat_long %>%
        group_by(group, k, MinMutPerRegion) %>%
        summarise(
          mean_n_regions   = mean(n_regions),
          median_n_regions = median(n_regions),
          sd_n_regions     = sd(n_regions),
          min_n_regions    = min(n_regions),
          max_n_regions    = max(n_regions),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        arrange(k, group)

      self$p_values <- self$calc_pvalues_from_reps(reps_df)

      self$violin_plot <- self$build_violin_plot_all(stat_long)
      self$violin_plot_mut1 <- self$build_violin_plot_mut1(stat_long, self$p_values)

      self$logit("NULL", paste0("Completed ", self$cfg$n_null_reps, " null reps"))
      invisible(TRUE)
    },

    run_all = function() {
      self$load_me3_regions()
      self$load_atac_and_genoa()
      self$load_and_filter_variants()
      self$build_overlap_tables()
      self$run_null()
      invisible(TRUE)
    },

    get_results = function() {
      list(
        config = self$cfg,
        me3_regions = self$me3_regions,
        case_overlap_table = self$case_overlap_table,
        control_overlap_table = self$control_overlap_table,
        per_region_counts = self$per_region_counts,
        null_reps = self$null_reps,
        melted_stats = self$melted_stats,
        p_values = self$p_values,
        violin_plot = self$violin_plot,
        violin_plot_mut1 = self$violin_plot_mut1,
        log = self$log_df
      )
    }
  )
)
```
## Native analysis dependencies

This chunk is disabled by default. Supply the original variant and lift-over files explicitly to perform a rerun.

```{r variant-native-analysis-dependencies, eval=isTRUE(params$run_variant_analysis)}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(
  {
    library(R6)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(GenomicRanges)
    library(IRanges)
    library(GenomeInfoDb)
    library(rtracklayer)
    library(data.table)
    library(readr)
  }
)
# The full class definition is included above.
variants_file <- Sys.getenv("CORTEX_VARIANTS_TSV")
liftover_chain <- Sys.getenv("CORTEX_LIFTOVER_CHAIN")
stopifnot(
  file.exists(variants_file),
  file.exists(liftover_chain)
)
```

## Original analysis call

The constructor below records the selected analysis settings. The implementation also checks input columns and harmonizes sequence levels. A normal render does not call `run_all()`.

```{r variant-original-analysis-call, eval=isTRUE(params$run_variant_analysis)}
analysis <- ME3_Exact_Enrichment_Run$new(
  me3_diffbind_path = file.path(
    repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "final_tables", "H3K27Me3_FTneg_Modality_H3K27Me3_PeakSet_me3_expand_bed_5000_Condition_FlashtagNeg__genotype_DBA_DESEQ2.csv"
  ),
  atac_path = file.path(
    repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "final_tables", "Supp_Table_1_ATAC_master.csv"
  ),
  genoa_path = file.path(
    repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "GENOA", "atac_idr_peaks_merged_uniform_genoa_strong_0.5-distal_and_proximal-mm10.bed"
  ),
  variants_tsv_path = variants_file,
  liftover_chain_path = liftover_chain,

  n_null_reps = 1000L,
  downsample_to = 5000L,
  downsample_frac = 0.8,
  rand_seed = 1234L,

  verbose = TRUE
)
analysis$run_all()
results <- analysis$get_results()
```


## Checkpoint-based figure export

The sections below use the verified saved results. Rerun outputs above are written separately and do not replace these inputs automatically.

## Figure 6g saved ASD gene null

Use all 10,000 stored null counts per population and the original observed overlap.

```{r figure-6g-saved-asd-gene-null-2}
for (pop in c("VZ", "nonVZ")) {
  d <- read_table("Fig6_KC", paste0("6g_", pop, "_Null_overlaps"))
  s <- read_table("Fig6_KC", paste0("6g_", pop, "_Statistics"))
  stopifnot(
    nrow(d) == 10000
  )
  x <- names(d)[2]
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x]])) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1,
      fill = "grey75",
      color = "white") +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = s$Observed_ASD_overlap,
      color = "#B2182B",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(x = "ASD gene overlaps",
      title = pop)
  export_panel(
    p, paste0("Fig6/6g_", pop, "_ASD_null"),
    5, 4
  )
}
```

## Figure 6h saved variant resampling

Plot the mean ± SD from the original saved balanced subsets. Primary criterion is at least one variant per region (k=0).

```{r figure-6h-saved-variant-resampling-3}
d <- read_table("Fig6_KC", "6h_Variant_plot_summary")
p <- ggplot(
  d, aes(
    factor(MinMutPerRegion),
    mean_n_regions, fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_n_regions - sd_n_regions,
      ymax = mean_n_regions +
        sd_n_regions
    ),
    position = position_dodge(0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(case = "#B2182B",
    control = "grey70")) +
  labs(x = "Minimum variants per region",
    y = "Regions (mean <U+00B1> SD)")
export_panel(p, "Fig6/6h_variant_resampling", 6, 4)
rep <- read_table("Fig6_KC", "6h_Variant_null_replicates")
stats <- read_table("Fig6_KC", "6h_Variant_statistics")
print(stats)
save_object(
  list(
    replicates = rep,
    statistics = stats,
    summary = d,
    parameters = read_table("Fig6_KC", "6h_Resampling_parameters")
  ),
  "variants/saved_resampling"
)
```
